nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: POST /audit with body { audit_id, url }. Requires Authorization header matching N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

nodes.name: Page Discovery
nodes.notes: Fetches sitemap.xml and prioritizes key pages. Outputs 5-10 pages to crawl.

nodes.name: Crawl Page
nodes.notes: Basic HTTP fetch for HTML extraction. Replace with Playwright community node for JS-rendered pages.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{JSON.stringify({ audit_id: $json.audit_id, base_url: $json.base_url, path: $json.path, full_url: $json.full_url, title: $json.title, meta_description: $json.meta_description, viewport_tag: $json.viewport_tag, canonical_tag: $json.canonical_tag, forms: $json.forms, links_count: $json.links_count, images_total: $json.images_total, images_no_alt: $json.images_no_alt, h1_count: $json.h1_count, h2_count: $json.h2_count, technologies: $json.technologies, crawled_at: $json.crawled_at, user_id: $env.OWNER_USER_ID })}}

={{JSON.stringify($json.issues.map(i => ({ audit_id: $('Update Status Crawling').first().json.body ? $('Update Status Crawling').first().json.body[0].id : $('Webhook').first().json.body.audit_id, category: i.category, severity: i.severity, title: i.title, description: i.description, evidence: i.evidence, recommendation: i.recommendation, classification: i.classification, user_id: $env.OWNER_USER_ID })))}}

nodes.name: Save Issues
nodes.notes: Batch insert of validated issues into audit_issues table.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{JSON.stringify({ ui_score: $json.ui_score, ux_score: $json.ux_score, performance_score: $json.performance_score, accessibility_score: $json.accessibility_score, seo_score: $json.seo_score, conversion_score: $json.conversion_score, overall_score: $json.overall_score, automation_score: $json.automation_score })}}

={{JSON.stringify({ model: 'deepseek-chat', temperature: 0.4, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You identify automation and improvement opportunities from website analysis. Given the audit data, issues, technologies, and scores, propose actionable opportunities. For each opportunity provide: title, category (one of: lead_capture, appointment, crm, ecommerce, email, whatsapp, support, quote, internal_workflow, ai_agent, seo, performance, ui_ux, other), observed_signal (what you detected), evidence (crawl data), inference (what it implies), confidence (0-1), business_impact (one of: high, medium, low), automation_potential (one of: high, medium, low), estimated_complexity (one of: simple, moderate, complex), recommended_tools (array of strings), recommended_workflow (text description), implementation_notes (text), outreach_angle (how to pitch this), score (0-100). Return a JSON object with an "opportunities" array.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Website: ' + $('Update Status Crawling').first().json.body[0].id + '

Pages crawled: ' + JSON.stringify($('Save Page').all().map(i => ({ url: i.json.full_url, title: i.json.title, forms: i.json.forms, technologies: i.json.technologies }))) + '

Technologies: ' + JSON.stringify($('Compute Scores').first().json.all_technologies) + '

Issues found: ' + JSON.stringify($('Parse AI Analysis').first().json.issues) + '

Scores: overall=' + $('Compute Scores').first().json.overall_score + ', seo=' + $('Compute Scores').first().json.seo_score + ', performance=' + $('Compute Scores').first().json.performance_score + ', accessibility=' + $('Compute Scores').first().json.accessibility_score + ', conversion=' + $('Compute Scores').first().json.conversion_score + ', automation=' + $('Compute Scores').first().json.automation_score }] })}}

={{JSON.stringify($json.opportunities.map(o => ({ audit_id: $('Update Status Crawling').first().json.body ? $('Update Status Crawling').first().json.body[0].id : $('Webhook').first().json.body.audit_id, title: o.title, category: o.category, observed_signal: o.observed_signal, evidence: o.evidence, inference: o.inference, confidence: o.confidence, business_impact: o.business_impact, automation_potential: o.automation_potential, estimated_complexity: o.estimated_complexity, recommended_tools: o.recommended_tools, recommended_workflow: o.recommended_workflow, implementation_notes: o.implementation_notes, outreach_angle: o.outreach_angle, score: o.score, user_id: $env.OWNER_USER_ID })))}}

nodes.notes: Insert each opportunity into audit_opportunities table.
